description: Direkto connects AI assistants to the live catalogs of participating Dutch suppliers. Ask which suppliers offer a product, what they sell, what a quantity costs and when it can be delivered. All prices, delivery times and product details come directly from the supplier's own data. Direkto does not sell anything itself and is not a party to the purchase: ordering and payment happen with the supplier.

defaultPrompt: Find suppliers in the Netherlands that sell cakes and pastries
Get a price and delivery date for 10 boxes of apple pie
Which suppliers can deliver pastries to my business next week?
